play.definition: A gap-scheme misdirection run featuring playside down blocks and two backside pullers—one to kick out the edge defender and one to lead through the hole. The running back takes an initial false step away before cutting back to follow the pullers.

Action_DownBlock.label: Down Block
Action_DownBlock.definition: An offensive lineman's block on a defensive lineman or linebacker to their inside, driving them towards the center of the line of scrimmage, often creating a hole outside or for a pulling lineman.

Action_None.label: None
Action_None.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

Action_PreSnap.label: Pre Snap
Action_PreSnap.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.
